meta.title: Battle Beacon | Find Your Trainer Community.
meta.description: Battle Beacon helps card game players discover local events, connect with collectors, and track their competitive journey.

hero.headline: Find Your Crew.
hero.subheadline: Battle Beacon helps trading card game players discover local events, connect with other collectors, and track their competitive journey. For stores, Beacon CRM keeps your tables filled and your community growing.

pain.sectionHeading: The Problem With How It Works Now
pain.sectionSubheading: Players miss local events, stores miss signups, and your competitive history exists nowhere.

items.title: Events Are Hard to Find
items.description: Pre-releases, local leagues, and casual game nights are scattered across Facebook groups, store websites, and word of mouth. You miss them constantly.

items.title: No Match History
items.description: Your competitive record lives on scribbled score sheets or not at all. There is no way to track your progress or see how far you have come.

items.title: Stores Miss Demand
items.description: Game stores struggle to fill event seats without a direct way to reach their player base and announce new formats as they drop.

items.title: Fragmented Communities
items.description: Players who want consistent weekly games have no shared hub to coordinate, find opponents, or stay connected between events.

solution.sectionSubheading: Everything card game players and game stores need in a single platform.

items.title: Find Events Near You
items.description: Discover pre-releases, leagues, draft nights, and store events in one place so you never miss a chance to play.

items.title: Track Your Journey
items.description: Log match results, build a player profile, earn badges, and show off your competitive progression to the community.

items.title: Store Tools & Automation
items.description: Beacon CRM gives game stores one place to manage event signups, player communications, and marketing without juggling separate apps.

cta.heading: Sign Up Before Launch
cta.subheading: Join early to claim your exclusive early adopter badge and be first to know when Battle Beacon goes live in your local game store.
